purpose: Transient output step must be positive.

oracle.derivation: Transient output step must be positive.

confirmed.result: ngspice-44.2 exits 1 (error on the .tran line); VACASK (unstable-2026) on the same circuit with `analysis tran1 tran step=0 stop=1m` prints "Transient time step must be greater than zero." and runs no transient. Xyce 7.10.0 accepts it.
